description:
Behind 3,000 industrial robots manufacturing new-energy vehicles lies an industry brain that orchestrates the entire factory, managing 1.8 billion product and process quality records and tracking 90,000 parameters per vehicle.
China's super factories are evolving from traditional assembly-line production to data-driven collaboration. Our reporters visit the SERES super factory in Chongqing for an inside look at China's intelligent manufacturing.
title: The industry brain behind the factory: How data reshapes car manufacturing in Chongqing

A major milestone for China's expressway network! The Sichuan-Yunnan Jinsha River bridge on the Yibin-Panzhihua Expressway was completed on Friday.
It connects Ningnan in Sichuan Province with Qiaojia in Yunnan Province, paving the way for the expressway's full opening.

author: New China TV
description: Ever seen China's version of heavenly angels? At Lingshan Scenic Area in Wuxi, China's Jiangsu, the show "Jixiang Yuan" (Auspicious Wishes) brings the beauty of the Flying Apsaras to life on stage. Evolving over centuries since Buddhism was first introduced to China, the Flying Apsaras have adorned the murals of China's Dunhuang Grottoes for nearly 2,000 years.
title: Flying Apsaras come to life on stage in China's Jiangsu

description:
Autumn paints a stunning picture in Yuli County, northwest China's Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region! Along the northern edge of the Taklimakan Desert, 1.6 million mu of ancient poplar trees are turning golden. Cruise along the Tarim River and admire their reflections dancing on the water, while flocks of birds forage, rest and bask in the sunshine.
A breathtaking scene where golden sands meet crystal-clear waters! #Xinjiang #AutumnScenery #PoplarForest (Recorded)
title: LIVE: Golden poplar forests and Shimmering Rivers in Xinjiang, China
